description: Use this to find the best Fantasy Premier League (fantasy football) players to pick or buy, by fplcopilot expected points (xPts, also called predicted or projected points), filtered by position, price, club or ownership, and sorted by points, value per £m, or as low-owned differentials. Classic FPL, not FPL Draft.

exclude.description: Players to leave out, e.g. ones they own
exclude.title: Exclude

exclude_flagged.description: Leave out flagged and fringe players (default true)
exclude_flagged.title: Exclude Flagged

horizon.description: How many gameweeks ahead to count (1-8).
horizon.title: Horizon

min_ownership.description: Min ownership %, e.g. 20 for template picks
min_ownership.title: Min Ownership

per_club.description: The best 1-3 at EACH club asked, in one table
per_club.title: Per Club

position.description: Position or positions: GK, DEF, MID, FWD
position.title: Position

sort.description: xpts (default, the total), value (xPts per £m), differential (low-owned), price, ownership, or one gameweek: next or GW12
sort.title: Sort

team.description: Club or clubs in one call, e.g. ARS or [ARS, CHE, LIV]
team.title: Team

name: find_players
title: Find players by expected points
